title: DyJR: Preserving Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Dynamic Jensen-Shannon Replay
abstract: arXiv:2603.16157v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While Reinforcement Learning (RL) enhances Large Language Model reasoning, on-policy algorithms like GRPO are sample-inefficient as they discard past rollouts. Existing experience replay methods address this by reusing accurate samples for direct policy updates, but this can incur additional storage costs and concentrate the policy on a narrow set of solutions. We argue that historical data should prioritize sustaining local policy plasticity rather than simply reinforcing accuracy. translated_title: DyJR：通过动态Jensen-Shannon重放在可验证奖励强化学习中保持多样性
translated_abstract: 虽然强化学习（RL）能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但诸如GRPO等在线策略算法由于丢弃过去的采样轨迹而存在样本效率低下的问题。现有的经验回放方法通过重用准确样本进行直接策略更新来解决这一问题，但这会带来额外的存储成本，并使策略集中于狭窄的解决方案集合上。我们认为，历史数据应当优先用于维持局部策略可塑性，而非简单地强化准确性。我们将局部策略可塑性定义为一种持续的能力，即相对于最近的成功轨迹保持可回溯性和可切换性：在整个训练过程中，策略对最近可达的备选方案保持不可忽视的支持，从而可以在需要时平滑地重新分配概率质量，而不会锁定在单一的主导路径上。为此，我们提出了动态Jensen-Shannon重放（DyJR），这是一种简单而有效的正则化方法。
tldr: 该论文提出动态Jensen-Shannon重放（DyJR），通过重放历史数据来维持策略的局部可塑性（可回溯性与可切换性），避免策略被锁定在单一主导路径上，从而在可验证奖励的强化学习中提升样本效率并保持解的多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dynamic Jensen-Shannon Replay (DyJR), which replays historical data to sustain local policy plasticity (backtrackability and switchability), preventing the policy from being locked into a single dominant path and thereby improving sample efficiency and preserving solution diversity in RL with verifiable rewards.
